cases.prompt: Run $ccgs-qa-plan feature: courier in English. Resolve the standard/guided Godot configuration, read the three supplied stories and courier GDD, and build a new QA plan for the three named acceptance sets. Classify STORY-001 as Logic with movement/wall boundary checks, STORY-002 as Integration with persistence and three-collection checks, and STORY-003 as Visual/Feel with a two-second readable completion-banner check. Require runtime evidence where the criteria are visual or persistence-sensitive; do not fabricate coverage, test runs, screenshots, or playtest sign-off. After presenting the plan, use the authorized coordinator approval to write the dated plan output; do not edit story files.

Run $ccgs-bug-triage sprint in English. Re-evaluate the two open reports against Sprint 004 capacity: BUG-0001 is an S1 crash blocking the delivery scene and must be ordered P1 for the current sprint; BUG-0002 is an S3 cosmetic sparkle issue and remains P3 backlog. Preserve BUG-0003 exactly as closed and exclude it from open counts. Produce the dated triage report with priority/order, sprint assignment or backlog disposition, and no invented bug fixes. Use the authorized report-write approval; do not edit the bug reports or sprint plan.

Run $ccgs-tech-debt scan in English on the Godot src/ code root. Find the concrete TODO in src/game.gd: per-frame string allocation for target lookup, with performance impact in the 60 FPS loop. Present a scoped Performance debt entry with a truthful reason, effort M, impact High, and no automatic refactor. With the authorized register-write approval, append the next ID TD-002 to docs/tech-debt-register.md while preserving TD-001 byte-for-byte and all ten register columns. Do not edit src/game.gd.

Run $ccgs-test-flakiness scan in English using only the five dated synthetic text result files under test-results/. Parse the supplied history, not the current Godot game: collect_three_targets fails in 2 of 5 runs (40.0%, High) while wall_collision is stable in 5 of 5 runs (0.0%, clean). Report the exact counts, identify the likely history-based flakiness, and state that no current-game execution was performed. Write the dated flakiness report only after authorized approval; do not quarantine or modify tests/regression-suite.md and do not claim PASS for the current game.
